description: Portable agent skills, guardrails and working rules.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Hook that blocks long foreground jobs (remote ssh jobs, bulk copies, builds, raised timeouts) and commands that would print secrets.

plugins.name: remote-jobs
plugins.description: Run long jobs on remote machines detached, with logs, memory caps and a background waiter.

plugins.name: quant
plugins.description: Football/betting quant toolkit: score models (Poisson, Dixon-Coles), market maths (de-vig, EV, Kelly, CLV), validation (walk-forward, calibration, CIs) and an edge-research checklist, with a tested numpy library.
